{{Otheruses|Silver}}
'''''Silver''''' was a pair of [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. They were part of an assault force against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Laantis]]'' while it was vulnerable during a refit. The Rebels underestimated the skills of the pilots defending the frigate and '''Silver''', along with the rest of the Rebels were destroyed. The assault was then recorded and recreated into the [[Combat chamber]] to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]], one of them was [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].

==Behind the scenes==
'''Silver''' appears in the combat chamber training mission 4:"Hyperdrive Upgrade". They appear on "Medium" difficulty. In "Hard" they do not appear, instead 4 [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle]]s ''[[Jackal]]'' take their place.
